affinity.notes: The saturated cyan gills and magical core suggest a distinct arcane or bioluminescent affinity.

anatomy.notes: Cap, torso, arms, and split root-legs read as one coherent fungal creature.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "ranged spore caster" does not semantically communicate Breathing-Cloud Specialist (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: The directional spore cloud clearly telegraphs a ranged cone or area attack.

finish.notes: Cap texture, fibrous body detail, glow, and particles are cleanly integrated.

framing.notes: The full creature and its active spore plume remain readable in frame.

identity.notes: Blind perception "fungal humanoid" semantically identifies fungalfolk/fungalfolk-sporeguard.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "standard" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
